verdict.rationale: GitHub Copilot Chat (docs-4, docs-22) and Autofix (docs-13) support natural-language explanation and vulnerability-fix suggestions, which enables NL-based debugging/troubleshooting. However, community feedback (comm-10) specifically criticizes vague 'fix the bug' NL debugging as unreliable and 'braindead', and other testimonials focus on code completion rather than debugging accuracy, indicating real-world limitations.
